algorithm.title: Ruptured ovarian cyst with hemoperitoneum

nodes.text: Sudden unilateral pelvic pain during luteal phase: evaluate for ruptured corpus luteum cyst
Exclude ectopic pregnancy: obtain immediate qualitative and quantitative serum beta-hCG
Transvaginal ultrasound demonstrates adnexal cyst with free fluid in pouch of Douglas
Assess hemodynamic stability: monitor serial vital signs and serial hematocrit
**Hemodynamically stable without active bleeding:** inpatient observation, rest, and analgesia
**Hemodynamically unstable or ongoing bleeding:** urgent laparoscopy with cystectomy
Prevent recurrent functional ovarian cysts: initiate combined oral contraceptive suppression

algorithm.title: Decreased fetal heart rate variability evaluation

nodes.text: Fetal heart rate variability reflects autonomic nervous system tone and cerebral oxygenation
Transient decreased variability without decelerations in reassuring baseline: fetal sleep cycle
Perform vibroacoustic stimulation to awaken fetus and elicit heart rate accelerations
**Reassuring accelerations follow stimulation:** confirms normal reactive fetal sleep state
**Persistent minimal variability beyond 40 minutes:** continuous fetal heart monitoring
Rule out maternal medications that induce central nervous system depression
Manage term premature rupture of membranes: offer oxytocin induction to reduce infection

algorithm.title: Postoperative fever evaluation following cesarean delivery

nodes.text: Evaluate postoperative fever by timing: wind, water, wound, walking, wonder drugs
Postoperative day 1 to 2 fever with decreased bibasilar breath sounds: pulmonary atelectasis
Physical exam excludes alternative sources: uterine tenderness, incision erythema, CVA tenderness
First-line management: incentive spirometry, aggressive pulmonary toilet, and early ambulation
**Fever persists beyond POD 3 with consolidative infiltrate:** treat for postoperative pneumonia
**Uterine fundal tenderness and foul lochia develop:** intravenous clindamycin + gentamicin
Ensure adequate multimodal analgesia to facilitate deep inspiration and coughing
